evidence.section: The Dwarf Kingdoms / Council of Elders
evidence.quote: he is also obliged to consult with a Council of Elders
evidence.claim: Official local government includes rulers and advisers. Naming an actual DF government is separate from naming its physical site or parent civilization; this does not confer Warhammer rank or create those offices.

evidence.quote: Clan Elders are responsible for updating
evidence.claim: Record-keeping is an attested duty of elders. Kron is a symbolic institutional motif; the generator creates no debt, ancestor record, promise, or real book.

evidence.quote: Most Dwarf words have several meanings.
evidence.claim: Every gloss selects an attested sense. These labels and their institutional use are new combinations, not published government names or a reconstruction of complete Khazalid grammar.

evidence.quote: Bar A fortified gateway or door
evidence.claim: Bar supplies a protective gate motif. Duraz and bryn supply stone and shining motifs; these do not imply actual buildings, materials or wealth.
Grong supplies the craft motif; grim selects the unyielding sense. Neither word confers guild standing or achievements.
Select the record sense; karak is enduring and kol selects the black-colour sense. No event or institutional age is generated.

evidence.quote: At the apex of a hold are clans with royal ties
evidence.claim: Rank and legitimacy depend on real social relationships. Exclude arbitrary king, ancestor, royal-clan and council-membership assertions from government labels.

evidence.quote: the Grimbar Gate guards the opening to the Underway
evidence.claim: Reserve Grimbar, which is an actual named gate; do not recycle its identity for a generated government.
Reserve Karak Grong and its joined spelling because the compound is an existing hold identity.
Material-record imagery is grounded in the description of Dwarf writing on hard materials and metal scrolls. These names do not generate records or give a government ownership of such objects.

Underground vaults are associated with Dwarf book storage. This supplies context for an architectural emblem alongside government record-keeping, without granting archives, a treasury, a temple connection, contents, or actual vaults.
Azul selects metal as an imagined emblem material, not dependable conduct, official standing, or an actual owned asset.
Galaz supplies ornamental-gold imagery while Gorl selects the separate yellow sense. Neither establishes actual wealth, tribute, rank, or gold-bearing property.

Khaz and Irkul provide underground-hall and pillared-vault emblems. Skarrenruf selects bright blue. All are symbolic labels, not local architecture, a constitutional office, or a new translation of council.
Only the red-colour sense is selected. The label does not record violence, a sacrifice, victory, or past event.
Silver and bread are attested independent concepts, not invented product or wealth claims.
The selected moonlight sense and the printed material, shadow, work and sunrise nouns add distinct concepts. No generic machine, dawn-direction, geology or ancestry meaning is invented.

The conjunction explicitly pairs two reviewed images. Thrag means wound, Thrynaz includes laws, Tiwaz includes rest and Skaud includes song. These are not new translations for hospital, government or tavern.

High-resolution printed text confirms Zunthrum with n. Spear, money, sunset, remembering and gift are independently attested; none assigns actual stock, wealth, a historical event or a commemorated person.
